deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into your Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
2. Click on the "Returns" tab and select the return policy you want to edit
3. Scroll down to the "Return reasons" section and click on the "Add a return reason" button
4. Enter a name for your return reason in the "Name" field, e.g., "Defective product"
5. In the "Description" field, enter a brief description of why this return reason is used
6. To add a capture form to collect additional information from customers when they select this return reason, click on the "Add a capture form" button
7. Select the type of capture form you want to use (e.g., text, dropdown, checkbox) and configure its settings as needed
8. Click "Save" to save your changes to the return policy
9. To test the returns flow with the new return reason and capture form, go to the "Customers" > "Orders" section and select an order that has a return request associated with it
10. Click on the "Return requests" tab and select the return request you want to edit
11. In the return request details page, click on the "Add reason" button next to the return reason dropdown menu
12. Select your newly created return reason from the list, which should now include a link to the capture form
13. Click on the link to open the capture form and test its functionality by submitting it with some sample data
